children: CORA GOLD LTD -  EAGLE EYE ASSET HOLDINGS INDICATED TO BOARD OF CORA THAT IT INTENDS TO RESTRUCTURE ITS AFFAIRS WITH COMPANY
CORA GOLD LTD - EAGLE EYE NOTIFIED CO THAT RESTRUCTURING WILL ENABLE CONSOLIDATION OF ITS INTERESTS IN CORA INTO A2MP
CORA GOLD LTD - EAGLE EYE IS CURRENTLY A 97.30% SHAREHOLDER OF A2MP WITH 2.70% BEING HELD BY FEDA MINING INVESTMENTS LIMITED
CORA GOLD LTD - UNDERSTANDS THERE IS NO CHANGE OF EAGLE EYE'S PLAN, STRATEGY AND INTENTIONS REGARDING SHAREHOLDING OR STREAM ARRANGEMENTS WITH CO
CORA GOLD - COMPLETION OF RESTRUCTURING RELATIONSHIP AGREEMENT BETWEEN CO & EAGLE EYE TO BE REPLACED BY NEW RELATIONSHIP AGREEMENT BETWEEN CORA & A2MP
CORA GOLD LTD - PURSUANT TO RELATIONSHIP AGREEMENT, A2MP WILL BE ENTITLED TO APPOINT ONE NON-EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR TO BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CORA
CORA GOLD - EAGLE EYE AND A2MP HAVE AGREED THAT POST COMPLETION EAGLE EYE'S REPRESENTATIVE ARYANN GUPTA WILL REMAIN A NON-EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF CORA

title: Cora Gold Says Eagle Eye Asset Holdings Indicated To Board Of Cora That It Intends To Restructure Its Affairs With Company
